description: Source: TxFlow. Read-only keyless perp reads: health, markets, fundingSnapshot (coins up to 20 from the reviewed TxFlow/RISEx mapping), book (coin, depth up to 20), fees (default taker/maker). Funding normalized from percent per settlement interval to decimal/hour; raw string kept. TxFlow has no public funding history. Unknown values stay null; stale data is labelled. Hosted disabled by default.

coins.description: Reviewed mapped coins, e.g. BTC; unmapped coins are refused

name: txflow
